The signature content itself is accurate, and core behavioral patterns (uses_first_name, uses_emoji) are correct.

knowledge.details: The system captured 11 of 14 contacts (79%) with good detail on topics and interaction patterns. Missing 3 automated contacts (Microsoft Outlook, Slack, StrategyCo Calendar) which are less critical for email drafting. Contact information is mostly accurate with correct names, emails, types, and tones. Projects section shows excellent understanding but differs structurally - system created 6 granular projects vs ground truth's 4 higher-level projects, which actually provides MORE useful context. The system added a helpful 'frequent_topics' section not in ground truth. Terminology overlap is ~60% with system providing more granular consulting terms that would be useful for email drafting. Minor precision issues: some titles missing (marked null), and David Chen incorrectly classified as 'colleague' vs 'direct_report'.

rules.details: Contact rules are 100% complete and accurate. General rules capture most core patterns (75%) but miss 3 important rules: consultant frameworks, action items with governance, and auto-reply patterns. System inferred additional rules (gratitude openings, subject lines, no emoji, encouragement) that aren't in ground truth but are plausible from the writing style. The contact rule closings are expanded to show actual signature text rather than '+ full signature' which is more actionable. Overall highly usable for email generation with minor gaps.
